run_single_checkpoint_evaluation: run a single checkpoint evaluation on a 3D object detection model using a specified config file and checkpoint path
run_all_checkpoint_evaluation: run evaluation on all checkpoints in a directory with automatic polling and tensorboard logging for 3D detection models
parse_config: parse command line arguments and load YAML config for OpenPCDet 3D object detection model evaluation
eval_single_ckpt: evaluate a single model checkpoint on the test dataset and save results to the specified output directory
repeat_eval_ckpt: repeatedly evaluate new checkpoints as they appear in a directory with tensorboard logging and epoch tracking
